name: SafeDollar reward pool deflationary-token accounting
summary: The SDO reward pool credited deposits and computed pending rewards from the amount passed in rather than the amount actually received, and SDO burns a fee on every transfer, so a deposit/withdraw/harvest loop kept minting rewards the pool could not back.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: the PoC carries no transaction hash, so the exploit tx was recovered by querying eth_getLogs on the reward pool 0x17684f4d5385FAc79e75CeafC93f22D90066eD5C across the PoC's fork block window (16225170-16225176), which yields exactly one transaction, 0x55dad44a...074b at block 16225172. The pool was created 2021-06-11T07:08:52Z by 0x82d733c32bb3b760ca50b83b75642b668e9b2ebd, not the attack-tx sender 0xfedc2487ed4bb740a268c565dacdd39c17be7ebd; no EIP-1967 events, 16.6 days old. Loss $0.2 million per the DeFiHackLabs 2021 index entry for this PoC.
